Five matter most for cloud-native: config, backing services, processes, disposability and logs

mwotxdilf13539.text:
reaplc the defiantion point with

A disposable process can’t rely on a local log file, which disappears with it. Twelve-factor treats logs as a time-ordered event stream written to standard output.

mwoviwkz2bx3bo.author: Pallavi
mwoviwkz2bx3bo.text:
Cloud-native design keeps requests independent so an elastic fleet can add or remove instances without losing user data. A stateless workload keeps no client data between calls; a stateful one must remember past interactions.
